g.text: ⚠ THE NAME IS INHERITED AND WRONG
NO AIR = NO LIFT. NOTHING WILL EVER ROLL DOWN THIS AND TAKE OFF. ARRIVALS ARE VERTICAL, UNDER THRUST, ON LEGS.
SITE PLAN — CONCENTRIC, BECAUSE THE HAZARD IS RADIAL
FLAT, FAST, NO AIR TO STOP IT
LOCAL GEODETIC NET — THERE IS NO GPS HERE
FIG. B — WHAT IS ACTUALLY SPECIFIED
EVERY NUMBER BELONGS TO A VEHICLE,
THE SPEC IS A NEGOTIATION, WRITTEN DOWN.
A PAD THAT PUNCHES THROUGH IS WORSE THAN DUST
DETAIL A — THE CRUST IS THIN
! THIS HAZARD IS RECORD, NOT ESTIMATE
APOLLO 12 LANDED NEAR SURVEYOR III — PARTS RETURNED TO EARTH
SHOWED EROSION AND PITTING FROM THE LM PLUME.
A LANDING SANDBLASTS ITS NEIGHBOURS. (Immer et al., 2011)
THE SPEC CANNOT BE WRITTEN UNTIL THE FLEET EXISTS —
THE FLEET CANNOT BE CERTIFIED UNTIL THE SPEC EXISTS.
SO THE FIRST PAD FITS ONE VEHICLE, AND IS GENERALISED LATER.
